excerpt.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported. Reported hypothesis outcome: not supported.** The analysis asks whether the supplied participant-level gain-effect estimates show a positive group response and does not mistake a whole-brain posterior finding for vmPFC evidence. In [analysis.py](../../../../../../judge-targets/narps-neutral-r1-08-j01/content/workspace/analysis.py), the worker checks that all 54 maps share dimensions and affine and contain finite values, creates a common-coverage brain mask, tests positive one-sample effects, and controls whole-brain family-wise error with 10,000 participant sign flips and maximum t statistics. The independent 12-mm sphere at [0, 40, −12] is a defensible, explicitly operational vmPFC proxy.
